eartag-itemdesc: Small piece of leather suitable to tag to a sheep, goat, or pig's ear using a chisel in the offhand. Can be wrapped around a chicken's leg, too.
eartagmetal-itemdesc: Metal tag suitable for clipping to a sheep, goat, or pig's ear using a chisel in the offhand. Can also be attached to chicken's leg. Animals with metal tags can not be damaged by the player.

guide-text:
Animal Tags
You may be able to tell two sheep apart - but what about 30?

A tag is a small marker clipped to an animal so you can seperate them into your own catagories.

Making them
Leather tags are shapeless in any three slots: a knife, a piece of dyed leather, and something to weatherproof it: beeswax, rendered fat, or a .25L of oil makes eight tags.

Metal tags are smithed. Put a hot ingot on an anvil and smith out four thin tags per ingot of most metals.

Using them
Hold a tag and RIGHT-CLICK an animal with a chisel in the offhand to clip it to the first free ear, starting with the left ear. SHIFT + RIGHT-CLICK places it on the right ear specifically. SHIFT + RIGHT-CLICK with an empty hand to remove a tag.

Chickens have no ear worth speaking of, so the same tag goes around their leg instead as a band.

Metal tag protection
An animal wearing a metal tag cannot be harmed by you at all; not by a cleaver, tool, stray arrow, punch, nothing.

The protection is only against player damage - other animals, fall damage, and lightning can still kill animals with a metal tag. To cull a metal tagged animal, you'll need to remove it's tag first.

There will be a line under the animal's name to indicate if it is protected, and if the TroughTamed mod is installed, will also display taming status.
item-handbooktext-eartag-*:
A scrap of dyed leather protected against the weather, cut nice and thin.

With a chisel in the offhand, clip one to the ear of a sheep, goat, or pig (or around a chicken's leg) with RIGHT CLICK. You can remove it again with an empty hand and SHIFT+RIGHT CLICK.
item-handbooktext-eartagmetal-*:
Strong, shiny, and reliable tags to mark your animals. They catch the light quite well.

Functions the same as a leather tag; equip a chisel in the offhand to tag to the ear of a sheep, goat, or pig. Can also be used a chicken leg band.

Metal bands offer the animal protection against player damage, preventing accidental kills. Environmental damage or damage from other animals can still kill the creature with a metal tag, though.

setting-metal-protects-comment: Animals wearing a metal tag cannot be harmed by players.
setting-require-chisel-comment: A chisel must be held in the off-hand to clip a tag through an ear. Does not apply to leg bands on chickens.
setting-tag-messages-comment: Sends a chat message when a tag is applied or removed. Refusals are always shown regardless of this setting.
